items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Marsalis' and clarifies '[Winton, son of Ellis Marsalis, pianist]'. The interviewee (Sam Jones) does not respond to this specific mention with any personal anecdote or confirmation of a relationship, only acknowledging the interviewer's point about talent.

ctx.x: Let me as you this--just to share some information with you in terms of like a lot of the things that I've been involved with in the last year and a half. Doing some things for the National Endowment ...I've been able to do some traveling to a lot of places and one of the things that I found that was very amazing to me and was an eye opener, was that, there is a lot of black talent out there, in differents parts of the country that for some reason or another is not being hooked up; is not getting the visibility.…
Marsalis -- [Winton, son of Ellis Marsalis, pianist]

Marsalis, . yeah. And his brother, the saxophonist, and these are like just a couple places that I know. There's a lot of talent out there. It seems you know, part of what's got to happen is some kind of network, has got to be built up, you know, to draw some of these people out of these areas so they know what's happening and then if they--I'm finding that they are out there

items.title: Ellis Marsalis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 7, 2020
items.q: But we did do a recording with Sam Jones, Cannon and Nat and Nat Perrilliat, James Black and me

ctx.x: You know, to Los Angeles. And we stayed at a little place in East L.A. — I don’t remember much about it. It wasn’t a lot. We didn’t have a lot of money anyway. But eventually Harold — I don’t know — no, he didn’t stay, not at that time. But I don’t know when he came back because my mom tracked me down and said well your dad is not feeling good and you need to come home. So there was a guy I knew who had gone to school with my future wife who was coming back to New Orleans so I hitched a ride with him. So when I…
Was there a concern about going to Korea?
